description: Loan and investment calculator in exact cents, no outside source. mode=annuity: monthly payment, total interest and the full amortisation schedule (up to 600 months). mode=compound: future value of an initial sum plus monthly contributions. mode=npv or irr: discount or internal rate of return of a list of cashflows (up to 200, the first at time 0). Rates are percentages from 0 to 100 a year (per period for npv and irr); terms up to 50 years. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

cashflows.description: Comma-separated cashflows for npv and irr, e.g. -1000,300,400,500 (first at time 0)

contribution.description: Monthly contribution for compound, up to two decimals (optional)

principal.description: Loan amount (annuity) or starting sum (compound), up to two decimals (optional for compound)

rate.description: Annual rate in percent, 0 to 100 (annuity, compound); rate per period in percent for npv (-99 to 1000)

termMonths.description: Term in months, 1 to 600, instead of termYears

termYears.description: Term in years, up to 50 (annuity, compound)
